KeysToEntries.ID_OUTPOST_DISMANTLE_NOTIF_BODY: Dismantle and receive these items in return:

KeysToEntries.ID_OUTPOST_FEATURE_DESCRIPTION_LONG: A first, experimental step at establishing a Topside presence, your Outpost is a home you may truly make your own. Connected to Speranza by unseen trails, you'll be able to decorate and expand your space, unbound by your neighbors' aesthetic sensibilities or inconsistent bed times. You'll also be able to conduct experimental research too dangerous for the delicate structural integrity of an underground settlement.
KeysToEntries.ID_OUTPOST_FEATURE_DESCRIPTION_SHORT: Your outpost is a place to decorate and make your own, as well as to conduct experimental research too dangerous for Speranza.
KeysToEntries.ID_OUTPOST_PROJECT_DESCRIPTION: With the Nomads' help, we've identified scattered locations across the Rust Belt that have so far escaped ARC's detection. Daring Raiders may take a first, tentative step towards carving out a small piece of Topside for ourselves.

ID_OUTPOST_FEATURE_TITLE.Note: The Outpost is a new feature: players will have a building outside of Speranza, a place they can make their own. They will be able to craft and place furniture and the feauture also comes with Metagame progression, for example a new Workshop Station. Max. char. limit: 16

ID_OUTPOST_FEATURE_DESCRIPTION_SHORT.Note: Shorter description for Outpost feature Max. char. limit: 155

ID_OUTPOST_BASE_ROOM.Note: Refers to the new building modules a player can build to make their Outpost bigger.

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_EXPAND_OUTPOST.Note: The base outpost consist of 1 module, but player can add more modules by expanding their outpost. Expansion requires resources and includes Metagame progression as well (eg : the expansion is a package that includes a new room they can select and the ability to Upgrade their new workshop station).

ID_OUTPOST_TOOLTIP_INCLUDES_VARIABLE_SLO.Note: Slots refers to where the player will be able to place Furniture & Stations in their Outpost.

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_BUILD.Note: Main action to build the selected module, confirming the Expansion.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_CATALOGUE.Note: This is the "crafting" menu from where the player can select furniture to craft/stations to install in their Outpost.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_FURNITURE_BLUEPRINTS.Note: Designs are the equivalent of Blueprints for Furniture: player can craft & Install Furniture if they find Designs and learn them, just like with Blueprints.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_SUBSLOT.Note: This is a defined area in the outpost where a placer can place a piece of furniture or a workshop station

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_PLACE.Note: Verb, Action menu- Button to confirme placement of item

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_OUTPOST_STORAGE.Note: This is a storage space widget with limited amount of slots, that can hold furniture/stations while players rearrange their Outpost.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_OUTPOST_STORAGE_ALT1.Note: Alternative name for the storage space widget.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_OUTPOST_STORAGE_ALT2.Note: Alternative name for the storage space widget.

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_OUTPOST_STORAGE_ALT3.Note: Alternative name for the storage space widget.

ID_OUTPOST_TOOLTIP_SUBSLOT_PLUS_ITEMS.Note: Information shown in the storage space if an item stored has populated sub-slots

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_DECORATIONS.Note: Opens a panel that shows a filtered view of everything in a player's stash that can be placed as decoration within sub-slots. Used as a header and as a button

ID_OUTPOST_TOOLTIP_FURNITURE_SIZE_SMALL.Note: refers to the different slot sizes

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_REMOVE.Note: Action to remove a selected Decoration

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_CLEAR.Note: Alternative name for action to remove a selected Decoration

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_MOVE.Note: Verb, Action Menu: when interacting with Furniture/Station in Outpost

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_STORE.Note: The action of putting an item in the storage/on hand

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_DECORATE.Note: Action menu: will open the Subslot menu to place Decoration on items that allow it

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_VISIT.Note: Action menu: on a Workshop Station, will send the player to the station's Crafting screen

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_SALVAGE.Note: Action menu: dismantling a piece of Furniture will give the player back only a fraction of the resource cost, hence "Salvage"

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_DECORATION_SLOTS_VARIABL.Note: Shown on a Furniture Item tooltip, so player know how many decoration slots would be available on selected item before purchasing it

ID_OUTPOST_BUTTON_INSPECT_ALT1.Note: A more friendly and less clinic version of "inspect" : zooms in the furniture

ID_OUTPOST_WARNING_ATTACHED_SENT_TO_STOR.Note: In case a player dismantle a furniture that contains sub-slots (eg: a Table that has 3 chairs attached to it). Needs to convey that "installed items will be sent to storage"
Alternative that doesn't use the word "sub-slots" but refer to items occupying these slots as being "attached" to the main furniture

ID_OUTPOST_PROMPT_SALVAGE_SUBSLOT_ALT1.Note: Alternative that doesn't use the word sub-slot

ID_OUTPOST_HINT_NAV_CHANGE_VIEW.Note: Bottom bar hint that allows player to navigate between different camera angles within the outpost

ID_OUTPOST_HINT_NAV_FREE_NAVIGATION.Note: Mode that allows the player to float and navigate freely around their Outpost, with no UI layer.

ID_OUTPOST_MODALE_HEADER_FEATURE_UNLOCKE.Note: Used in popups or other places

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_OUTPOST_DESCRIPTIO.Note: screen/expansion: Something about the outpost consisting of different rooms to be decorated, and the Outpost coming with 1 base room. When players are on the Outpost tab for the first time, after finishing the Project. Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_OUTPOST_EXPANSION.Note: screen/expansion: Something about Outpost expansion: why would the player want to expand, When the players enters the Outpost tab for the second time Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_OUTPOST_CHANGE_VIE.Note: screen/expansion: Highlights the "Change View" hint in the bottom bar to see the Outpost from a different angle, when player expand their Outpost. Not sure "select" should be in this sentence Max. char. limit: 160
alternative, depending on how we name the action hint. Max. char. limit: 160
room/furnishing: HIghlight the relevant bottom bar hint inside the Outpost room. Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_ROOM_SLOTS_COMPATI.Note: room/furnishing: Something about some slots being compatible only with Furniture and other only with Workshop stations Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_DRAG_AND_DROP.Note: room/furnishing: Something about being able to move furniture and stations around by drag and dropping them between compatible slots (mouse & keyboard version) Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_MOVE.Note: room/furnishing: The same as above, except for gamepad -With gamepad, players can press A on a focused piece of furniture or station and move the joystick to the destination slot Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_SWAP.Note: room/furnishing: Same as above, except with no mention of "drag and drop" or gamepad - Maybe a neutral disclaimer that players can always move and swap furniture and even salvage them Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_ATTACHED_SLOTS.Note: room/furnishing: Something about being able to attached decoration or smaller pieces of furniture to some furnitures Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_ACTIONS_MENU.Note: room/furnishing: HIghlights the "Actions" hint in the bottom bar when player has furniture or station in focus, which opens the Action Menu. Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_ONBOARDING_STORAGE.Note: room/furnishing: Description of the "storage/on hand" interaction, when the Action Menu is open. Player can store up to {0} pieces of furniture or stations there Max. char. limit: 160

ID_OUTPOST_MENU_SUBSLOT_ATTACHED.Note: Some furniture will have sub-slots: for example, installing a table will reveal 4 sub-slots to place chairs. Or slots where players can place trinkets or decoration on top of a furniture.
